state: the State line is drawn as 'State: <text>' above the form
reload: Qt ChiMol viewer button; the native 3D tab is a CA-trace plot with the donor/acceptor sites, no reload needed
3dstructureviewport(nomodulenamed'chisur: Qt ChiMol viewer error text (the Qt viewer does not build here); replaced by the native 3D Structure tab
pdbnone(3dviewportready): Qt ChiMol viewer status text; replaced by the native 3D Structure tab
sequencebarunavailable(needschisurf): Qt ChiMol sequence bar error text; residue picking in the viewer is not ported (set chain/residue in the form)
.*: table/regex data of the Qt viewer, not a control
\\b: table/regex data of the Qt viewer, not a control
?: Qt help glyph; the card has Help and Guide buttons
acceptor: Qt label of the FRET panel; the card has the full 'Acceptor ...' fields
radius(å): Qt label of a FRET field; the card names it 'Acceptor dye radius (Å)'
